fix: Do not deep-clone the glyph run per paint. Keep `run.clone()` (an Arc bump) and emit the line origin as a translation instead: push `PaintCommand::PushTransform { transform: CoreTransform::translation(origin) }` before the runs of a line whose origin is non-zero and `PaintCommand::PopTransform` after them, as `paint_semantics_debug_label` already does. Then the `if origin == Offset::ZERO` branch and the per-run `Arc::new` both go away.

This runs per pointer event for every sliver viewport whose children use mixed paint scopes. `sliver_paint_slots` already allocates a Vec of slots (scrolling/geometry.rs:63), so this is a second allocation. Compute the reordered child list in a reused buffer on the element/viewport (cleared and refilled only when the children change), or have `hit_children` return the slot order and iterate `node.children` through it without collecting, so the hit path does not allocate per event.

`transient_portal_entries` (retained.rs:621) returns an owned Vec that every `hit_test`, `pointer_hit_test` and `raw_hit_elements` call builds per pointer event while popups are open. Make it return a double-ended iterator borrowing `self.tracked` (`-> impl DoubleEndedIterator<Item = (...)> + '_`) so `.into_iter().rev()` is a plain reverse walk with no allocation. Same change applies to the loops at painting.rs:240 and :323.

Each visited node with a raw annotation allocates its own `elements` Vec and the parent then copies it, so a pointer event allocates once per annotated ancestor on the path. Pass a single `&mut Vec<ElementId>` sink down `collect_pointer_hit_render` / `collect_pointer_hit_children` (children push into the sink before the parent pushes its own element, so order is unchanged) and truncate the sink to its previous length when a non-content-hit overlay result is discarded (painting.rs:379-383). Reuse the sink's capacity across events via a scratch buffer.

Clones a whole SemanticNode (strings, actions, children) per node per paint while the SemanticsDebugger is on, only to dodge the `&mut self` borrow used by `paint_semantics_debug_label`. Borrow instead and finish with the borrow before the label call: `let Some(node) = self.semantics.node(id) else { continue; };`, copy `bounds`, compute `message = semantics_debug_message(node)`, push `node.children` onto `stack`, then call `self.paint_semantics_debug_label(...)` after the last use of `node`.

Opt-in SemanticsDebugger only. Build the label with a single `String` and `write!` into it (`use std::fmt::Write`) instead of a Vec of Strings joined at the end, and reuse one buffer across nodes so the debugger does not allocate per node per paint.
